First, we find the two numbers in the table that $0.9480$ lies between. These numbers are $0.9474$ and $0.9484.$ So, we have the following inequality:

$$
\begin{aligned}0.9474 & <0.9480<0.9484\end{aligned}
$$

Writing the above inequality in terms of $Φ,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}Φ(1.62) & <Φ(z)<Φ(1.63).\end{aligned}
$$

So, using interval bisection, we can approximate $z$ as

$$
z≈\frac{1.62+1.63}{2}=1.625.
$$
